# CoRL 2026 people directory

Public research data, snapshot 2026-11-01. 4066 author identifiers, 687 accepted papers.
All paths below are relative to this file's website root.

- assistant.html: reading and recommendation instructions with JSON example.
- data/authors-index.json: small entry manifest; topic indexes and 100-author chunks.
- people/index.html: all-author HTML directory with linked pagination, readable without scripts.
- people/<name>-<id-hash>/index.html: individual public research profile.
- people/<name>-<id-hash>/profile.json: same profile as structured data.
- authors.html?author=<encoded-author-id>: open the author in the interactive workbench.

Start with the manifest and the relevant topic chunks; then read candidate profiles.
Use stable author IDs, deduplicate candidates, and substantiate reasons with paper IDs.
Do not infer personal identity from names. name_style describes spelling only.
First position, confirmed equal contribution, correspondence, and project leadership are distinct.
Oral/Spotlight are paper-level signals. Attendance and unknown roles are unconfirmed.
Private lists, groups and notes are not part of public data and cannot be read via these URLs.
Return JSON: {"schema_version":1,"source":"assistant name","recommendations":[{"author_id":"...","reason":"...","paper_ids":["..."],"group_names":["..."]}]}.
